steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Here we are.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We have to go up to the rooftop?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...This door is locked.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Stand back, I'll blast it open--

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: There's no need for that.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Just kick it down.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Liskarm, you should learn from her.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I have my own way of doing things. Got a problem with that?!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: There's another rooftop in front of us...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I think I'm beginning to understand...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Amiya, over there! You'll be able to cross over from there!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Where is 'there'... Are you telling us to--

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Jump from rooftop to rooftop?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Bingo~!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Who would ever expect this? See, this is foolproof!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: You know, Lungmen is a great place with many secrets--

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: You're not getting away!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: ...Huh? What's going on? !

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Exusiai, the enemy showed up unexpectedly...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I already sealed off the entrance, so how...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Could they have come from the nearby buildings...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They seem to be wearing some rudimentary jetpack, but it's enough to get the job done.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We'd be at a disadvantage if they managed to sneak through places we aren't able to defend...

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Tch... Hold on, I'll be there to help you shortly.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Don't take too long, my little guardian angel.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Defenders, get into formation! Pronto!

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...I'm going in.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Everyone, protect our vanguard!
